invitationMessage.subject: Join {institution} as a coordinator on Friends of Animals
invitationMessage.email:
Hello,

{inviter} has invited you to be a teacher coordinator for {institution} on Friends of Animals. Coordinators help their school take part in FOA's competitions.

To accept, open this link, then sign in or create an account with this email address:
{link}

The link works until {expiresAt}. If you weren't expecting this, you can ignore this email.

Friends of Animals
invitationMessage.sms: {institution} invites you to coordinate on Friends of Animals. Sign in with this number to accept by {expiresAt}: {link} -FOA

meta.title: Coordinators
meta.description: Invite teachers to coordinate for your institution on Friends of Animals, and remove coordinators.

manage.title: Coordinators
manage.lead: Teacher coordinators help your institution take part in competitions. Invite them by email or mobile number.

noInstitution.title: No institution to manage here
noInstitution.body: Only the authorised person of a verified institution can invite coordinators. If you registered an institution, it shows here once FOA has verified it.

manage.empty: No coordinators yet. Invite a teacher below.
manage.invitationsEmpty: No invitations are waiting for an answer.
manage.expired: The link stopped working on {expires}. Send a new invitation if they still need one.
manage.inviteLead: We send them a link that works for 7 days. They accept it signed in with the same email or mobile number.

errors.invalid_input: Enter an email address or a 10-digit Indian mobile number.
errors.sms_disabled: We can't send invitations by SMS yet. Invite them by email instead.
errors.already_coordinator: They are already a coordinator here.
errors.cannot_invite_self: That is your own email or number. You already manage this institution.
errors.institution_not_verified: Your institution isn't verified at the moment, so it can't invite coordinators.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

outcome.removed: Coordinator removed. They can no longer act for your institution.
outcome.withdrawn: Invitation withdrawn. Its link no longer works.
outcome.not_found: That coordinator or invitation is already gone.
outcome.already_accepted: That invitation was already accepted, so it can't be withdrawn.

meta.title: Coordinator invitation
meta.description: Accept an invitation to be a teacher coordinator for an institution on Friends of Animals.

invitation.title: Become a coordinator
invitation.invitedTo: You're invited to be a teacher coordinator for {institution}.
invitation.signInLead: Sign in, or create an account, with {address}. Then open the link in your invitation again.

mismatch.title: This invitation is for someone else
mismatch.body: You're signed in with a different email or mobile number. Sign out, then sign in with {address} and open the link again.
mismatch.action: Go to your sessions to sign out

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitation links work for 7 days. Ask {institution} to send you a new one.

revoked.title: This invitation was withdrawn
revoked.body: Ask {institution} for a new invitation if you still need one.

notFound.title: This link doesn't work
notFound.body: Check that you opened the whole link from your invitation, or ask your institution to send a new one.

errors.not_found: This link doesn't work any more.
errors.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your institution to send a new one.
errors.identifier_mismatch: This invitation is for a different email or mobile number than the one you're signed in with.
errors.institution_not_verified: This institution can't add coordinators at the moment. Please try again later.
